actions.description: Execute a named, versioned process recipe on a process controller with declared parameters and return the exit status and a report artifact.

inputs.description: File name of an uploaded protocol in /data/user_storage/ with its .py suffix; letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only, because the upstream inserts it unquoted into a shell command
inputs.name: recipe_ref

inputs.description: True to run opentrons.simulate instead of opentrons.execute
inputs.name: dry_run

actions.name: run_protocol

facts.text: The repository is a SiLA 2 controller for an Opentrons OT-2 liquid handler
The module sets the default private key path ~/.ssh/ot2_ssh_key, the login user root and the protocol directory /data/user_storage/

The constructor loads an RSA private key from pkey_path or the default path, adds unknown host keys automatically (AutoAddPolicy) and connects to device_ip as DEVICE_USERNAME without a timeout argument
get_Connection returns the device IP and the hex fingerprint of the loaded private key
get_AvailableProtocols runs ls on USER_STORAGE_DIR and keeps the lines for which endswith('.py') holds, stripping each line only after that test
get_CameraPicture captures one 640x480 frame from /dev/video0 with ffmpeg and downloads the JPEG over SCP

RunProtocol appends ProtocolFile unquoted to USER_STORAGE_DIR in the command python3 -m opentrons.simulate when IsSimulating is true and python3 -m opentrons.execute otherwise, and passes that string alone to exec_command
RunProtocol prints every remote stderr line and then every remote stdout line on the host's standard output
RunProtocol returns the remote exit status and raises ValueError only when a simulated run's status is not 0
The feature's abstract base declares get_Connection, get_AvailableProtocols, get_CameraPicture, UploadProtocol, RemoveProtocol, RunProtocol and CameraMovie, and no stop, pause or abort method
The destructor closes the SSH connection
The command-line entry calls server.stop() on the SiLA server once Enter is pressed
The protocol is identified by its uploaded file name including the .py suffix
A camera picture is a current JPEG of the deck taken with the built-in camera
Protocols executed directly on the robot hardware omit the initial calibration steps, and incorrect positioning of the pipettes may be the consequence
The SiLA server runs on a host computer that has to be connected to the OT-2 via SSH

measures.description: Device IP and the hex fingerprint of the local SSH private key, formatted by the feature from its own fields; it does not show whether the SSH session is open
measures.name: connection

measures.description: Protocol files the upstream lists under /data/user_storage/; its filter tests each ls line before stripping the newline that Paramiko's readlines keeps (ot2controller_impl.py:54), so a real OT-2 is expected to report an empty list
measures.name: available_protocols

safe_state.description: None reached: the e-stop closes this driver's SSH client, the upstream's only teardown (ot2controller_impl.py:159-161), and no line of the clone stops, pauses or aborts the remote python3 -m opentrons.execute process, so the protocol may keep running on the OT-2 after the e-stop and the e-stop is reported SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held
